title: Multi-Agent Social Simulation: An Experimental Framework for Language-Native Social Experiments

contributions.purpose: 提出语言原生的多智能体社会实验框架 MASS
contributions.mechanism: LLM 作为主体间性(intersubjective)代理,回合制环境执行政策冲击,记录数值动作+一句话意图理由,识别(DID)放在分析层而非模拟规则
contributions.evaluation: 定性:给出最小充分协议(时间粒度/外生规则/自主性/对照/独立复现)
contributions.domain: 计算社会科学/LLM 社会模拟
contributions.source_quote: We introduce Multi-Agent Social Simulation (MASS), a language-native experimental framework in which large language models (LLMs) act as intersubjective agents.

contributions.purpose: 用经典最低工资案例做效度信度检验
contributions.mechanism: 重演 NJ-PA 最低工资(round 9 涨至$5.05),46 周 DID + 独立复现 + 反事实组 C
contributions.evaluation: 起薪 DID ≈+$0.65/h,就业效应统计上与零无异,价格轻微变动;反事实组 C 无此模式
contributions.source_quote: MASS reproduces the classic Card–Krueger pattern—post-policy starting wages rise (about $0.65/h), employment effects are statistically indistinguishable from zero, and prices move only mildly.

contributions.purpose: 用意图文本做机制审计
contributions.mechanism: 每回合返回"做X以达成Y"意图,连接对话链到因果链,不回喂状态更新以防泄漏
contributions.evaluation: 定性:D 组强制该字段显著提升可解析性
contributions.source_quote: we use intention texts to link dialogue chains to causal chains for mechanism audits.

self_declared_provenance.quote: it complements natural experiments by enabling controlled and repeatable interventions when real-world shocks are opportunistic; it extends classic ABM by bringing language-based coordination and justification into the loop; and it retains the auditability that expert wargaming typically lacks.

notes: accept。负结果/trade-off(带数字):checklist 自认因 vibe-coding 慢(>3周数千轮)被迫把计划的 30-round testbed 砍到 4 runs(A/B/C/D)。数据红旗:Table 2 就业 DID 四组数值剧烈发散(A=8.606, B=-13.619, C=-28.908, D=-1.478 FTE),却统称"与零无异",仅凭 4 次运行且宽 CI 支撑"employment≈0"结论,可疑;反事实组 C 就业 -28.9 更像噪声而非干净对照。checklist AI 披露:Writing=D、Analysis=D、设计=C;自认幻觉参考文献需人工核、sycophancy/过度正面、长会话易崩。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+conclusion 归纳三条。
